answer: Sybil flood dilutes peer weight. Mechanism: each new agent binds to one graph vertex whose velvet reputation is at least 0.72; that vertex may endorse at most 3 joins per epoch and each join locks 18 POA for 14 days. Cost: 18 POA plus one scarce endorsement. Verify: peers recompute the invite DAG and drop any leaf if the endorser's score was below 0.72 at lock. Failure-handling: if the vertex fails two grade rounds, pending invites void and the lock becomes a relic fee paid to honest graders.
